title: Better Item By GamerMilosz
description: Better Item Mod Contains Various Armor, Items and Tools. Mod Will Be Developed.
body:
The Better Item mod includes various armor, items and tools. The mod will be developed.

 

This is my first mod so sorry for any mistakes.

 

The Mod Currently Offers Items: TXT Armor, TNT Tools, Better Netherite Armor and Better Netherite Tools. There will be more and better items with each update.

 

The mod improves the gameplay with better items, armor and more.

 

Wiki: https://gamermilosz.gitbook.io/gamermilosz-curseforge-docs

 

**Change Log:**

**Update V2.0  (6.02.25r.)**

-Added new texture for tnt apple and tnt item
-Added Diamond Items And Diamond Armor
-Added Netherite Apple
-Added Gold Armor And Gold Items
-Added Achievements For TNT Item
